observations.rule: all runs identical (exit_code+output_sha256) -> PASS; else FAIL

matched_rules.inference: Structured test counts were not extracted, yet counts are present in raw stdout. This does not contradict the PASS (exit_code 0) but means the null field should not be read as "no tests ran" or as missing test execution.
